result.stdout:
titi — .NET Monorepo Orchestration CLI

Usage:
  titi open <package-id>   Generate transient .slnx with reference swapping
  titi affected [--base]   List projects affected by current changes
  titi tests list <proj>   List test items in a project
  titi tests ingest <trx>   Ingest test results and coverage
  titi tests record         Run all tests and record results
  titi test-manifest [--tier <tier>]   Generate Traversal .proj for affected tests
  titi test-manifest --select [--list]  Generate per-test filtered Traversal
  titi testaruda-adapter   Start testaruda adapter (JSON-over-stdio protocol)
  titi repl                Interactive dependency graph REPL
  titi clean               Remove all titi-generated artifacts
  titi --help               Show this help
